scripts.build: npm run build -w @vibeone/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @vibeone/plugin-runtime && npm run build -w @vibeone/example-workspace-tools
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.mjs tests/chat-timeline.test.mjs tests/tool-presentation.test.mjs tests/composer.test.mjs tests/conversation-history.test.mjs tests/package-bridges.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && cargo test --workspace && npm run host:test && npm run storage:test
scripts.host:test: cargo build -p vibeone-host && node --test tests/workbench.test.mjs tests/execution.test.mjs tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/plugins.test.mjs tests/attachments.test.mjs tests/history.test.mjs
scripts.plugin:scan: npm run build && cargo run -p vibeone-host -- plugin scan --workspace .
scripts.remote:test: npm run build:web -w @vibeone/desktop && cargo build -p vibeone-host && node --test tests/remote.test.mjs
